title: The tortoise who wanted to fly
text: Once upon a time there was a tortoise called Lola who watched the birds every morning. One day she asked a swallow: how do you fly? The swallow laughed kindly and said: you don't have wings, but you have something I don't have, a house that goes with you everywhere. Lola thought about it all day. That night, looking at the stars from her shell, she found out that she didn't need to fly to see the sky. And she fell asleep smiling. The end.

title: The moon goes to sleep
text: When the sun gets tired of shining, the moon puts on her silver pyjamas. She says hello to the owl, who wakes up, and to the fireflies, who light their little lanterns. She sings a lullaby to the sea so the waves calm down. And when morning comes, the moon yawns, tucks herself under a soft cloud, and tells the sun: your turn. Good night, moon. Good night to you too. The end.

title: The dragon with hiccups
text: Nico the dragon had hiccups, and every time he went hic, a colorful bubble came out instead of fire. The villagers, who used to be afraid of him, came out to see the bubbles. The children chased them and laughed. Nico was embarrassed, until a girl told him: that's the most beautiful thing I've ever seen. Since then, whenever someone in the village is sad, Nico drinks water upside down to get hiccups on purpose. The end.
